Why Ryan?



- Competitively Paid Internship
- Award-Winning Culture
- Paid Holidays (La Fête Nationale du Québec (QC), Canada Day, Civic Holiday (AB,ON, QC), British Columbia Day (BC))
- Mentorship Opportunities and Hands-On Training
- Networking with Industry Leaders
- All-Expense-Paid Trip to Ryan Headquarters in Dallas, TX

The Software Engineering Intern will gain hands-on experience developing and enhancing enterprise-level software products and internal platforms that support Ryan's business operations and property tax solutions. This role provides opportunities to strengthen technical skills, explore AI tools and technologies, and collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

Duties And Responsibilities



- Collaborates with software engineers and technical leads to develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise-level software applications.
- Participates in software testing, debugging, and troubleshooting to identify and resolve application issues.
- Assists with integrating application components, APIs, and databases to support software functionality.
- Works with cross-functional teams, including Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and Product Management, to support development projects.
- Participates in team meetings, code reviews, product demonstrations, and Agile development activities.
- Gains exposure to cloud-based development, deployment processes, and DevOps practices.
- Explores the use of AI tools and emerging technologies to support software development and process improvements.
- Documents code, testing results, and technical processes to support knowledge sharing and maintainability.
- Learns and applies software development best practices, coding standards, and quality assurance processes.

Education And Experience



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Academic coursework or project experience in software development, programming, or application design.
- Preferred: Experience with C#, .NET Core, ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar programming languages and frameworks.
- Preferred: Exposure to cloud technologies, particularly Microsoft Azure, and Agile development methodologies.

Professional Skills Requirements



- Work effectively in a fast pace, high-energy environment.
- Strong problem solving, attention to detail, and communication skills.
- Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, and manage ambiguity.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels.
- Intermediate knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications, Outlook, and etc.

Computer Skills



- Foundational knowledge of programming concepts, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.
- Familiarity with software development tools, version control systems, and debugging techniques.
- Basic understanding of frontend or backend application development.
- Interest in learning cloud technologies, AI tools, and modern software development practices.

Certificates And Licenses

Valid driver's license required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Equal Opportunity Employer: disability/veteran
fit_why: Full-stack-ish SE intern; .NET/C# preferred, he lacks it; Azure and TypeScript overlap

Work Location
Onsite, 4-5 days per week. 
Office Location: 6230 E Stassney Ln, Austin, TX 78744
Candidates must be local to Austin, TX or surrounding areas.**


Job Description
We are currently seeking a contract AI/ML Engineer Intern to be a key resource on a technical services team for our client, the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT).


Responsibilities
The AI Innovation team in ITD undertakes rapid development initiatives using AI/ML tools and platforms with the goal to drive business innovation at the client.

- Evaluate emerging AI trends, tools, and vendor solutions against business use-cases.
- Run proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to test feasibility of new ideas.
- Design and build applications and AI/ML models tailored to specific use cases (e.g., predictive analytics, natural language processing, computer vision) prioritized for the AI Program.
- Create scalable AI pipelines that can be integrated into existing systems.
- Collaborate with data, engineering, and software development teams.


Qualifications
Minimum (Required):

- Strong Python, familiarity with Java/ C++/ Go for production environments
- Object-oriented programming & design patterns
- Unit testing, CI/CD, Git, containerization (Docker)
- Data pipelines (Airflow, Prefect, or cloud-native equivalents)
- Model deployment (REST APIs, gRPC, serverless), monitoring, and versioning)
- AWS/Azure/Google Cloud Platform/OCI AI services
- Cloud-native training/inference environments (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML)
- Kubernetes for scalable inference


Company Overview
Allied Consultants has been contracted with the Texas State Government for 34 years, we are a Top Ten ranked vendor, and premier provider of technical and business staffing solutions. Allied Consultants offers its family of consultants excellent rates, a local support staff, and an attractive benefits package which includes medical insurance (Allied shares a percentage of the cost), life insurance, a matching 401(k) plan and a cafeteria plan. Candidates selected for interview will be required to undergo criminal background checks and may be required to complete a drug screen in accordance with Federal and State Law. Offers of Employment are contingent on a successful background check. Allied Consultants is an equal opportunities employer.
